Indikator 5 measures the fulfillment percentage (psychoeducation rate) for ADHD treatment pathways across Danish regions and specific child and adolescent psychiatric departments, as tracked by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]]. The national standard or development goal for this indicator is set at 90% [^src1] [^src2]. However, the data reveals that no region or department comes close to meeting this target, with all entities falling significantly short [^src1] [^src2].

At the regional level, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] consistently leads the country, achieving a 50% fulfillment rate in both the 2023 and 2024 reporting periods [^src1] [^src2]. In the 2023 report, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] followed with 43% [^src1], improving to 50% in the 2024 report [^src2]. Conversely, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] ranks at the bottom among regions, recording just 7% in the 2023 data [^src1] and slightly improving to 9% in the 2024 data [^src2]. The national average remained relatively flat, hovering around 34% in the 2023 report [^src1] and 33% in the 2024 report [^src2]. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] saw a decline from 42% to 35% across the two reports [^src1] [^src2], while [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] remained largely stagnant at 32% and 33% [^src1] [^src2].

When examining specific departments in the 2024 data, [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] emerges as a clear outlier and the absolute leader, reaching an 81% fulfillment rate [^src2]. This is the closest any unit gets to the 90% threshold. On the other end of the spectrum, several facilities report a 0% fulfillment rate, including [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]], [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-udredning|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning]], and BUA Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatri - Sengeafsnit [^src2]. Other notable departments include [[bispebjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] at 23%, [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] at 37%, [[glostrup-bup-ambulatorium|Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] at 34%, and [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] at 49% [^src2]. Ultimately, the data underscores a systemic failure to meet the 90% psychoeducation target across all levels of the Danish psychiatric system for ADHD [^src1] [^src2].
